dct_description_sm: Across top of map: Union Pacific Railway and connections.
Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image.
Contributors: Rand McNally and Company; Union Pacific Railway Company
County map of the United States showing relief by hachures, drainage, cities and towns, and the railroad network with emphasis on the main line. Scenic illustrations border the map.
dct_title_s: New map of the Union Pacific Railway, the short, quick and safe line to all points west
